Biography

Kyle Min is a Principal Applied Scientist at Oracle, working on video generation, multimodal AI, and personalization. Previously, he was a Staff Research Scientist at Intel Labs, where he led work on multimodal learning, reliable AI, and video understanding. He received his Ph.D. from the University of Michigan, advised by Prof. Jason Corso.

Highlights

Technical focus: frontier video generation, multimodal AI, personalization, and reliable AI

Applied AI experience: post-training, customer-driven personalization, production-oriented prototyping, and model improvements

Publications: 20+ peer-reviewed papers at CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, and NeurIPS, with oral and spotlight recognitions

Service: Area Chair, NeurIPS 2026; Vice President, KSEA Seattle Chapter; AI Expert Committee Member, K-TAG U.S. Chapter
